stats.name: npc_dota_hero_bane
stats.npe_desc_loc: Puts his enemies to sleep, incapacitating them

official.name: bane_enfeeble
official.desc_loc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
official.lore_loc: Each tendril of fear that Atropos weaves increases the vulnerability of his victims to arcane and unknown arts.

officialZh.name: bane_enfeeble
officialZh.desc_loc: 每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿特洛波斯编织的每一丝恐惧都使他的受难者承受更多的奥术和未知技艺伤害。

official.name: bane_brain_sap
official.desc_loc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
official.lore_loc: Atropos finds no greater pleasure than to harvest the fear he creates.
official.shard_loc: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%. Causes Brain Sap to become a %shard_radius% AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: bane_brain_sap
officialZh.desc_loc: 暴食一个敌方单位的生命能量，造成伤害并回复自身生命值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿特洛波斯认为收割被他亲自制造的恐惧弄崩溃的生命是至高的享受。
officialZh.shard_loc: 减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成%shard_radius%作用范围的技能。次级目标只有%shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。

official.name: bane_nightmare
official.desc_loc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
official.lore_loc: A stolen prowess from the goddess Nyctasha is to put his prey into forever sleep.
notes_loc: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
facets_loc: Bane has increased attack speed when attacking Nightmared units.
Nightmared units walk in Bane's chosen direction.

officialZh.name: bane_nightmare
officialZh.desc_loc:
让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从夜之女神妮塔莎那里偷来的能力，让猎物一觉不醒。
notes_loc: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。
facets_loc: 祸乱之源在攻击噩梦中单位时获得额外的攻击速度。
噩梦中单位会朝选定方向走去。

official.name: bane_fiends_grip
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
official.lore_loc: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.
official.scepter_loc: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

officialZh.name: bane_fiends_grip
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 抓住一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并持续受到大量伤害，同时每%fiend_grip_tick_interval%秒按目标最大魔法值一定比例吸取魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿特洛波斯的受害者经常因为噩梦中逼真的幻象痛不欲生。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 魔爪的冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受%scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

official.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha
official.desc_loc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

officialZh.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha
officialZh.desc_loc: 每次祸乱之源击杀敌方英雄，或者他们在祸乱之源的负面效果下阵亡，他们都会在游戏的剩余时间内获得一层恐惧的效果，使敌人对祸乱之源施加的负面状态的<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>减少。

special_values.name: max_terrors
special_values.heading_loc: 每名英雄最高恐惧叠加层数：

special_values.name: status_resistance
special_values.heading_loc: 每层恐惧降低<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>：

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker
stats.npe_desc_loc: Chases down low health enemies with increased speed

official.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
official.desc_loc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
official.lore_loc: Strygwyr shares his animalistic thirst for bloodshed.
notes_loc: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
official.shard_loc: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal %max_health_dmg_pct%%% of the target's max health as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
officialZh.desc_loc: 使血魔陷入渴望鲜血的狂怒中，以每秒流失一定百分比生命的代价获得攻击速度和技能增强加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 史德利古尔与人分享他那野兽般的嗜血饥渴。
notes_loc: 对血魔造成的伤害不致死。
officialZh.shard_loc: 血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成%max_health_dmg_pct%%%目标最大生命值的<font color="#d8ae53">纯粹</font>伤害。

official.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
official.desc_loc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
official.lore_loc: The Flayed Twins are ever willing to aid those who spill blood upon the field of battle.
notes_loc: Total time is a %delay% second delay plus a %abilitycastpoint% second cast time.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
officialZh.desc_loc: 血魔用圣血为一片区域洗礼。%delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip%秒后祭祀完成，区域范围内所有敌人都会受到伤害，并被<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只要有人在战场上遍洒鲜血，那么剥皮双子就乐于向他施以援手。
notes_loc: 总时间为%delay%秒的施法时间加上%castpoint_tooltip%秒的生效延迟。

official.name: bloodseeker_thirst
official.desc_loc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
official.lore_loc: Strygwyr becomes frenzied when blood is spilled.
notes_loc: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.
facets_loc: Can be activated to grant bonus movement speed and %sanguivore_multiplier%x Sanguivore heal bonus for a short duration. While on cooldown, passive Thirst move speed is reduced by %inactive_penalty_pct%%% . Cannot be cast when all enemy heroes are at full health.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_thirst
officialZh.desc_loc: 血魔能够感知到敌人的伤口中涌出的鲜血，敌方英雄的生命值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%，他的移动速度就会提升，而且生命值越低，提升效果越大。如果生命值低于%invis_threshold_pct%%%，他还将获得该英雄的视野和真实视域。焦渴的效果可以叠加。血魔可以突破最大速度限制。
officialZh.lore_loc: 史德利古尔闻到血腥味就会变得无比狂热。
notes_loc: 幻象不能触发该技能。
移动速度加成在敌人生命值低于%max_bonus_pct%%%时达到上限。
目标死亡后效果延续%linger_duration%秒。
facets_loc: 可以主动开启，短时间内获得移动速度加成和%sanguivore_multiplier%倍食血动物治疗加成。技能冷却时焦渴的被动移速加成减少%inactive_penalty_pct%%%。无法在所有敌方英雄满血时施放。

special_values.name: active_movement_speed
special_values.heading_loc: 主动开启时移动速度加成：

official.name: bloodseeker_rupture
official.desc_loc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
official.lore_loc: When the Bloodseeker hunts you, injuries become fatalities.
official.scepter_loc: Increases initial damage and grants %AbilityCharges% Rupture Charges.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_rupture
officialZh.desc_loc: 让一个敌方单位皮开肉绽，根据其当前生命值造成初始伤害。单位移动后会根据移动的距离受到伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当血魔猎杀你时，受伤就意味着死亡。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升初始伤害，并且提供%AbilityCharges%点割裂能量点数。

official.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
official.desc_loc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to %base_heal% health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
notes_loc: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
officialZh.desc_loc:
血魔每杀死一个单位都会回复部分生命，回复量为基础%base_heal%点加上该单位最大生命值的一定百分比。

友军击杀了附近的敌方英雄时会回复半额数值。
notes_loc: 非英雄单位的吸血效果减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。

special_values.name: half_bonus_aoe
special_values.heading_loc: 半额<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>作用范围：

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_morphling
stats.npe_desc_loc: Rides the waves to flank enemies

official.name: morphling_waveform
official.desc_loc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
official.lore_loc: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.
facets_loc: Waveform attacks enemies in his path. Does not apply on-hit effects.

officialZh.name: morphling_waveform
officialZh.desc_loc: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。
officialZh.lore_loc: 轻松卷走敌人的滔滔洪水。
facets_loc: 波浪形态会攻击路径上的敌人。不会施加攻击特效。

official.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
official.desc_loc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
official.lore_loc: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.
notes_loc: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
facets_loc: Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.

officialZh.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
officialZh.desc_loc:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 变体精灵唤出自身的元素，构成波浪碾碎对手。
notes_loc: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
facets_loc: 变体打击会根据变体精灵的力量值造成眩晕。

official.name: morphling_morph_agi
official.desc_loc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
official.lore_loc: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
notes_loc: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
official.shard_loc: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

officialZh.name: morphling_morph_agi
officialZh.desc_loc: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些力量以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成敏捷。该过程可逆。
officialZh.lore_loc: 不断变化的流水让变体精灵的本质很难被辨别。
notes_loc: 属性变换不能转化物品提供的属性加成。
升级敏捷获取时也会升级力量获取。
officialZh.shard_loc: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

official.name: morphling_replicate
official.desc_loc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
official.lore_loc: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
notes_loc: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
official.scepter_loc: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

officialZh.name: morphling_replicate
officialZh.desc_loc: 使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标<font color="#FF0000">改变</font>自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
officialZh.lore_loc: 凝视变体精灵会映出一个能够模仿本体的倒影。
notes_loc: 变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 变形增加<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。

official.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
official.desc_loc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
notes_loc: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

officialZh.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
officialZh.desc_loc: 变体精灵根据当前力量值获得额外施法距离和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，根据当前敏捷值获得攻击距离和移动速度。这些效果在他变形为其他英雄时仍然有效。
notes_loc: 变形期间的攻击距离加成只有在变形为远程英雄时有效。

special_values.name: slow_resist_per_str
special_values.heading_loc: 力量转为<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>：

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer
stats.npe_desc_loc: Creates illusions of himself to trick or attack foes

official.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
official.desc_loc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
official.lore_loc: Azwraith's proficiency at spearing his family's meal of fish is proving quite useful in the battlefield.
notes_loc: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
official.scepter_loc: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
facets_loc: Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
officialZh.desc_loc: 对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿兹瑞斯对于用长矛捕鱼养家的精通被证明在战场上非常有用。
notes_loc: 幻影长矛手附近%fake_lance_distance%范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 灵魂之矛可以向范围内敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先。提升灵魂之矛的幻象继承攻击力。
facets_loc: 幻影长矛手幻象放出的灵魂之矛会造成%illusion_lance_damage_pct%%%长矛伤害。

official.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
official.desc_loc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Dread Magus Vorn's death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to bend and fracture all spectrums of light.
notes_loc: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
facets_loc: Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
officialZh.desc_loc:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过%delay%秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受%illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少%illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 恐怖巫师沃恩的死亡让幻影长矛手获得了将自身在所有光线之中弯折破碎的能力。
notes_loc: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。
facets_loc: 幻影长矛手每缺失%hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%%生命都会额外产生一个幻象。

official.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
official.desc_loc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
official.lore_loc: Azwraith knows that on the field of battle, speed can mean everything.
notes_loc: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
officialZh.desc_loc: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿兹瑞斯明白，瞬息万变的战场上，速度就是一切。
notes_loc: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为%bonus_speed%。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

official.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
official.desc_loc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Each of Azwraith's lance attacks feels like two from a normal warrior; or three; or four...
official.shard_loc: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
facets_loc: Juxtapose Illusions spawn on random nearby units and deal more damage but can't be controlled.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
officialZh.desc_loc: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿兹瑞斯的每次刺击感觉就像一个普通战士的两次，或三次，或四次……
officialZh.shard_loc: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。
facets_loc: 并列的幻象会在附近随机单位身旁产生，继承更高的攻击力，但是无法控制。

official.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
official.desc_loc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
officialZh.desc_loc: 幻影长矛手只要制造出幻象，该幻象的继承攻击力不会低于一定值，持续%duration%秒。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_puck
stats.npe_desc_loc: Orbs to enemies and silences them

official.name: puck_illusory_orb
official.desc_loc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed. At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
official.lore_loc: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.
notes_loc: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

officialZh.name: puck_illusory_orb
officialZh.desc_loc:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。 在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
officialZh.lore_loc: 顽皮的仙女龙很喜欢捉弄他人，突然消失再意想不到地重现。
notes_loc: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

official.name: puck_waning_rift
official.desc_loc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
official.lore_loc: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.
facets_loc: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.

officialZh.name: puck_waning_rift
officialZh.desc_loc: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 帕克淘气地一笑，洒出中断魔法流动的附魔粉尘。
facets_loc: 新月之痕会把敌人推开。如果技能设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），会把他们拉近。

official.name: puck_phase_shift
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
official.lore_loc: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.
notes_loc: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
official.shard_loc: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

officialZh.name: puck_phase_shift
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 带着嘲笑，帕克瞬间回到了她的异维度故乡。
notes_loc: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。
officialZh.shard_loc: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

official.name: puck_dream_coil
official.desc_loc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
official.lore_loc: The Faerie Dragon sows confusion by forcing its enemies to vividly dream about their own mortality.
official.scepter_loc: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

officialZh.name: puck_dream_coil
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和<font color='#e3d59e'>束缚</font>。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 仙女龙散播混乱，让敌人陷入鲜活的梦境，见证自己死亡的命运。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时攻击也会继续。

official.name: puck_puckish
official.desc_loc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

officialZh.name: puck_puckish
officialZh.desc_loc: 每当帕克躲避攻击时，它就会分别回复最大生命值和最大魔法值的%mana_and_health_restore_pct%%%。躲避指向性技能的弹道将回复%dodged_spell_multiplier%倍数值。防御塔的攻击不会对此生效。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_sand_king
stats.npe_desc_loc: Burrows to stun and slow enemies

official.name: sandking_burrowstrike
official.desc_loc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
official.lore_loc: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

officialZh.name: sandking_burrowstrike
officialZh.desc_loc:
沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克里瑟历斯经常钻入地下埋伏，等待伏击敌人。
notes_loc: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

official.name: sandking_sand_storm
official.desc_loc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
official.lore_loc: Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.
notes_loc: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
facets_loc: Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.

officialZh.name: sandking_sand_storm
officialZh.desc_loc: 沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
officialZh.lore_loc: 有人认为克里瑟历斯只是传说中的幻影，因为他的甲壳在闪烁荒原的沙尘中总是若隐若现。
notes_loc: 沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。%fade_delay%秒后将再次隐形。
facets_loc: 沙尘暴的作用范围提升，并且沙王在其中获得隐身效果。
沙尘暴能以%sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%%沙王移速的速度跟随沙王，并且只要和沙王相距不超过%sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster%就不会消失。
当沙王在沙尘暴中攻击敌人时，他会对目标施加致盲的负面状态。

official.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
official.desc_loc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
official.lore_loc: Crixalis is certainly capable of mercy, but the soul of the sand finds few foes worth sparing.
official.shard_loc: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.

officialZh.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心%inner_radius%范围内敌人将受到%inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克里瑟历斯当然有怜悯之心，但是沙之魂并没有发现有多少敌人值得他的饶恕。
officialZh.shard_loc: 被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

official.name: sandking_epicenter
official.desc_loc: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
official.lore_loc: Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.
notes_loc: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
official.shard_loc: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
official.scepter_loc: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).

officialZh.name: sandking_epicenter
officialZh.desc_loc: 经过%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
officialZh.lore_loc: 许多探险家丧生于闪烁荒原的流沙。
notes_loc: 地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
officialZh.shard_loc: 每%shard_interval%秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 地震的脉冲开始时每%spine_tick_rate%秒会在随机地点产生%scepter_explosions_per_pulse%片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的%scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%%，对击中的敌人造成%spine_damage_pct%%%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生%shard_explosions_per_pulse%次攻击。

official.name: sandking_caustic_finale
official.desc_loc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.
official.lore_loc: An injection from Crixalis makes one brittle and as dry as the arid wastes, subject to implosive demise.

officialZh.name: sandking_caustic_finale
officialZh.desc_loc: 沙王的攻击对敌方单位注入毒液，使他们死亡时发生剧烈爆炸，造成固定数值的伤害加上基于阵亡单位最大生命值的额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克里瑟历斯的毒液让受害者变得脆弱并且干涸如干旱的荒地，最后爆炸而死。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_tiny
stats.npe_desc_loc: Grows in size and strength as battle ensues

official.name: tiny_avalanche
official.desc_loc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

officialZh.name: tiny_avalanche
officialZh.desc_loc: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当受到山岭巨人召唤时，毫无生气的石头也会很有杀伤力。

official.name: tiny_toss
official.desc_loc: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
official.lore_loc: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
notes_loc: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is %duration%s.

officialZh.name: tiny_toss
officialZh.desc_loc: 抓起小小身旁%grab_radius%范围内最近的单位，不论敌友，扔向目标单位或神符，落地时将造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 小小那巨大的身形让他能够随意抛起最强壮的勇士。
notes_loc: 你可以投掷队友，但他们不会受到伤害。
投掷对建筑物造成33%的伤害。
可以对减益免疫单位施放，但是不能将他们扔起，或对他们造成伤害。
飞行时间是%duration%秒。

official.name: tiny_tree_grab
official.desc_loc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
official.lore_loc: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
notes_loc: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

officialZh.name: tiny_tree_grab
officialZh.desc_loc: 抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 木棍和石头就能让骨头散架，而建筑也将马上步其后尘。
notes_loc: 树木扔出后技能进入冷却。

official.name: tiny_grow
official.desc_loc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
official.lore_loc: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
official.shard_loc: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

officialZh.name: tiny_grow
officialZh.desc_loc: 小小崎岖的身体不断成长，提升了攻击力、移动速度、护甲和投掷的威力，但攻击速度降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 亲眼看着丘陵变成山峦是震撼的——特别是这座山将他的敌人毁灭的时候。
officialZh.shard_loc: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。

official.name: tiny_insurmountable
official.desc_loc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes_loc: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

officialZh.name: tiny_insurmountable
officialZh.desc_loc: 小小从力量中获得<font color='#b99012'>状态</font>和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>还会降低攻击速度减少的影响。
notes_loc: 不可逾越不会减少长大的攻击速度降低效果。

special_values.name: str_to_slow_resist_pct
special_values.heading_loc: <font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>的力量值系数：

special_values.name: str_to_status_resist_pct
special_values.heading_loc: <font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>的力量值系数：

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit
stats.npe_desc_loc: Can swap herself with any nearby hero

official.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
official.desc_loc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
official.lore_loc: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.
official.shard_loc: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
facets_loc: Magic Missile deals %damage_per_lasthit% bonus damage for every creep the enemy has killed.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
officialZh.desc_loc: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 魔法箭是天怒一族的简朴战技，现在也是仙德尔莎主要的复仇工具。
officialZh.shard_loc: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的%bounce_range_pct%%%魔法箭施法距离内。
facets_loc: 魔法箭造成额外伤害，敌人每击杀一个非英雄单位为%damage_per_lasthit%点额外伤害。

official.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
official.desc_loc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
official.lore_loc: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
officialZh.desc_loc: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。
officialZh.lore_loc: 仙德尔莎那挥之不去的低语暗示着她的裁决将至。

official.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
official.desc_loc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
official.lore_loc: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.
notes_loc: Break disables the damage aura.
official.scepter_loc:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
officialZh.desc_loc: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得%self_multiplier%%%额外加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管盟友可能不会理解她对于复仇那无休止的热爱，但作战时他们还是会利用她的狂热。
notes_loc: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。

复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

official.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
official.desc_loc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
official.lore_loc: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.
notes_loc: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
officialZh.desc_loc: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 牺牲只是为了复仇付出的小小代价。
notes_loc: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

official.name: vengefulspirit_retribution
official.desc_loc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals %bonus_damage%%% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_retribution
officialZh.desc_loc:
复仇之魂的攻击同时被视为远程和近战，可以获得相应加成。

只要敌方英雄击杀了复仇之魂，他们会获得一个负面效果，直到下次阵亡，期间复仇之魂会对他们造成%bonus_damage%%%额外伤害。同一时间只能存在一个负面效果。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_kunkka
stats.npe_desc_loc: Disrupts enemy positioning and disables them

official.name: kunkka_torrent
official.desc_loc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
official.lore_loc: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.
notes_loc: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

officialZh.name: kunkka_torrent
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 世界中心喷涌出的上古之洪流，应舰队统帅的召唤而来。
notes_loc: 初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。

official.name: kunkka_tidebringer
official.desc_loc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
official.lore_loc: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.
facets_loc: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.

officialZh.name: kunkka_tidebringer
officialZh.desc_loc: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 迷失的铁帆海军灵魂依附在昆卡信赖的宝剑——潮汐使者之中，助它消灭洪流恶魔。
facets_loc: 潮汐使者每击中一名英雄，冷却时间都会减少。

official.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
official.desc_loc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
official.lore_loc: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.
facets_loc: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.

officialZh.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
officialZh.desc_loc: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。
officialZh.lore_loc: 舰队统帅诸多神秘能力中的一种，能用于战斗或娱乐。
facets_loc: X标记送回目标后，昆卡和回归点附近友军都会获得幽灵船的统帅朗姆酒效果。

official.name: kunkka_ghostship
official.desc_loc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
official.lore_loc: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
notes_loc: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.
official.scepter_loc: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

officialZh.name: kunkka_ghostship
officialZh.desc_loc:
召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。

被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 铁帆舰队最后的战舰虽然只是个幻影，但它给昆卡的敌人带来的死亡却是完全真实的。
notes_loc: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为%ghostship_speed%。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 幽灵船在目标地点以%fleet_interval%秒的间隔产生%fleet_count%艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射%num_cannon_volleys%波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成%cannon_ball_damage_pct%%%幽灵船伤害。

official.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
official.desc_loc: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
official.lore_loc: Deleterious to landlubbers, no one holds their rum like a sailor.
notes_loc: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

officialZh.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
officialZh.desc_loc: 如果昆卡受到来自敌方英雄、建筑或肉山的伤害会使他的生命低于%damage_threshold%%%临界值，那么他会浸在统帅朗姆酒中，获得移动速度加成，并且延后承受即将受到的%ghostship_absorb%%%伤害，持续%buff_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 朗姆酒对于旱鸭子来说就是毒药，他们不像水手，喝两口就醉了。
notes_loc: 在朗姆酒效果消失后造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman
stats.npe_desc_loc: Summons powerful serpent wards to deal damage

official.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
official.desc_loc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Originally used to open shows with the travelling con-man, Rhasta's lightning display shocks adversaries in more ways than one.
notes_loc: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
officialZh.desc_loc: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 最初是给流浪艺人作开场秀用的，罗斯塔的闪电之炫能分成数叉来震击不止一个对手。
notes_loc: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。

official.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
official.desc_loc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
official.lore_loc: Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a chicken - now, the humiliation is shared.
notes_loc: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
officialZh.desc_loc: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 罗斯塔通常将自己变成一个小鸡来结束表演——现在他把这个屈辱分享给别人了。
notes_loc: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

official.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
official.lore_loc: A self-defense incantation, Rhasta developed shackles after his master was slain in the Bleeding Hills.
official.scepter_loc: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一个用于自卫的咒语，是罗斯塔的师傅在流血丘陵罹难后，他所开发的枷锁咒。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

official.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
official.desc_loc: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
official.lore_loc: Snake charming was a big part of the Shadow Shaman's act; now Rhasta can empower the snakes to do his bidding.
official.shard_loc: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
facets_loc: Summons a single massive Serpent Ward with %mega_ward_multiplier_damage%x damage and %mega_ward_multiplier_health%x health and bounty values.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤%ward_count%个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 耍蛇曾是演艺中的重头戏；现在罗斯塔可以授予蛇力量，以服从他自己的吩咐。
officialZh.shard_loc: 可以使用巨蟒之瓮技能制造一个巨蛇守卫。
facets_loc: 召唤一个巨大的毒蛇守卫，攻击力为%mega_ward_multiplier_damage%倍，生命值和击杀金钱为%mega_ward_multiplier_health%倍。

official.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
official.desc_loc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: Rhasta had to learn early on how to stay one step ahead of those who (rightfully or wrongfully) wished him harm.
notes_loc: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
official.shard_loc: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
officialZh.desc_loc:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 罗斯塔必须尽早学会如何能快人一步，抢到哪些想（正当或不正当地）伤害他的人前头。
notes_loc: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。
officialZh.shard_loc: 伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_lich
stats.npe_desc_loc: Unleashes a powerful attack that bounces between enemies

official.name: lich_frost_nova
official.desc_loc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.
official.lore_loc: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.

officialZh.name: lich_frost_nova
officialZh.desc_loc: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续%abilityduration%秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冰霜法师艾斯瑞安从没忘记哪怕最简单的冰系操控咒。

official.name: lich_frost_shield
official.desc_loc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
official.lore_loc: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.
notes_loc: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
facets_loc: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.

officialZh.name: lich_frost_shield
officialZh.desc_loc: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每%interval%秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在人世的那些年最初学会的护身法术，而艾斯瑞安现在编织在周围的冰霜魔法随着时间愈发冰冷。
notes_loc: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。
facets_loc: 每当敌人死于冰霜魔盾的效果下，技能的持续时间都会增加。

official.name: lich_sinister_gaze
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
official.lore_loc: Mind the cold...
official.scepter_loc: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

officialZh.name: lich_sinister_gaze
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当心寒意……
officialZh.scepter_loc: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

official.name: lich_chain_frost
official.desc_loc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
official.lore_loc: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.
notes_loc: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
facets_loc: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.

officialZh.name: lich_chain_frost
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
officialZh.lore_loc: 几乎所有人都认为是冰霜法术中的终极咒语，艾斯瑞安的霜死之珠能用恐惧击打那些胆敢站出来反对他的人们。
notes_loc: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。
facets_loc: 连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
连环霜冻击杀敌人后会增加弹跳次数。

official.name: lich_death_charge
official.desc_loc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes_loc: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

officialZh.name: lich_death_charge
officialZh.desc_loc:
牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。

游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
notes_loc: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_riki
stats.npe_desc_loc: Remains permanently invisible until the moment to strike

official.name: riki_smoke_screen
official.desc_loc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
official.lore_loc: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.
notes_loc: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
official.shard_loc: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.

officialZh.name: riki_smoke_screen
officialZh.desc_loc: 丢下一个烟雾弹，<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
officialZh.lore_loc: 自从力丸在背叛之夜逃脱后，他就很看重利用朴素的烟幕来迷惑对手。
notes_loc: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。
不能阻止使用物品。
officialZh.shard_loc: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低%armor_reduction%点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

official.name: riki_blink_strike
official.desc_loc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
official.lore_loc: The Stealth Assassin's agile movement makes him impossible to escape.

officialZh.name: riki_blink_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成%slow_pct_tooltip%%%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 隐形刺客迅捷的动作让他的目标几乎不可能逃脱。

official.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
official.lore_loc: The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
facets_loc: Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.

officialZh.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的%interval_targets%个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 隐形刺客从不忌讳使用肮脏的战斗手法，尤其擅长从对手的背后发动攻击。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离至%AbilityCastRange%。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有%scepter_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升%scepter_bonus_duration%秒，并且额外发动%scepter_bonus_attacks%次攻击。
facets_loc: 绝杀秘技攻击非英雄单位时拥有%creep_agility_multiplier%倍敏捷加成。只要力丸在绝杀秘技期间击杀一个非英雄单位，冷却时间就会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%秒。

official.name: riki_backstab
official.desc_loc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
official.lore_loc: Riki comes for you.

officialZh.name: riki_backstab
officialZh.desc_loc: 力丸遁入阴影，变为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。
officialZh.lore_loc: 力丸来找你了。

official.name: riki_innate_backstab
official.desc_loc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes_loc: Works when denying friendly units at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.
facets_loc: Riki receives bonus experience for assists and kills.

officialZh.name: riki_innate_backstab
officialZh.desc_loc: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。
notes_loc: 反补友方单位时具有%ally_multiplier%%%效果。
力丸的幻象也会有背刺的动作，但是不会造成额外伤害。
facets_loc: 力丸获得助攻和击杀时会获得额外经验。

special_values.name: bonus_xp_assist_other
special_values.heading_loc: 击杀守卫/信使奖励经验：

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_enigma
stats.npe_desc_loc: Traps and damages enemies in a black hole

official.name: enigma_malefice
official.desc_loc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Strange gravities pull at the core of those who would oppose you, holding them in place.
official.shard_loc: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

officialZh.name: enigma_malefice
officialZh.desc_loc: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。每%tick_rate%秒<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>一次。
officialZh.lore_loc: 奇特的重力将敌人的重心进行拖拽，让他们动弹不得。
officialZh.shard_loc: 憎恶的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间增加%shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%秒，并且每次<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

official.name: enigma_demonic_conversion
official.desc_loc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
official.lore_loc: Enigma is capable of drawing aspects of himself from other dimensions - the result is a trio of dark eidolons that hunt the corporeal plane.

officialZh.name: enigma_demonic_conversion
officialZh.desc_loc: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的%current_health_pct%%%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 谜团具备将自身的形体吸入另一个维度的能力——随之产生的就是三个追猎肉体位面的暗黑虚灵。

official.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
official.desc_loc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
official.lore_loc: A section of the world slowly descends into the void.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.

officialZh.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
officialZh.desc_loc: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成%base_damage% + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 世界的一部分缓缓跌入虚空。
notes_loc: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。

official.name: enigma_black_hole
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
official.lore_loc: The ground trembles as Enigma channels his ultimate vortex of destruction, a singularity with the power to end worlds.
official.scepter_loc: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.

officialZh.name: enigma_black_hole
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 谜团将毁灭的终极漩涡，具有毁天灭地力量的奇点进行引导，大地因此颤抖。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位%scepter_pct_damage%%%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个%scepter_radius%范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为%scepter_drag_speed%。

official.name: enigma_event_horizon
official.desc_loc: Units in a %radius% radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

officialZh.name: enigma_event_horizon
officialZh.desc_loc: %radius%范围内的单位远离谜团时会受到移速惩罚。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_tinker
stats.npe_desc_loc: Demolishes his enemies with swarms of machines

official.name: tinker_laser
official.desc_loc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
official.lore_loc: Boush perfected this rock cutting laser in his subterranean laboratory, never considering its combat utility.
official.scepter_loc: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

officialZh.name: tinker_laser
officialZh.desc_loc: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
officialZh.lore_loc: 鲍什在他的地下实验室完善了这把激光岩石切割器，但并未考虑到它的作战效用。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。

official.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
official.desc_loc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
official.lore_loc: Even though the laboratory has since been sealed off, the ability to radio in robotic drones is still in working order.
notes_loc: Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.
official.scepter_loc: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
facets_loc: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.

officialZh.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
officialZh.desc_loc: 征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就算实验室最后被封锁了，呼叫机械无人机的无线电还是畅通的。
notes_loc: 机器人的产生速率是每秒%machines_per_sec%个。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。
facets_loc: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

official.name: tinker_deploy_turrets
official.desc_loc: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
official.scepter_loc: Turrets fire missiles %missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%% faster.

officialZh.name: tinker_deploy_turrets
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 炮塔发射导弹的速度加快%missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%%。

official.name: tinker_rearm
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
official.lore_loc: A new battery here, another set of rockets there, Boush continually improves on existing technology.

officialZh.name: tinker_rearm
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 这儿换块新电池，那儿塞几枚火箭弹，鲍什不断改进现有的技术。

official.name: tinker_eureka
official.desc_loc: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.

officialZh.name: tinker_eureka
officialZh.desc_loc: 修补匠的每%int_per_one_cdr%点智力提供%one_percent_tooltip%%%物品冷却时间减少，最多为%max_cdr%%%。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_necrolyte
stats.npe_desc_loc: Damages enemies and heals allies simultaneously

official.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
official.desc_loc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
official.lore_loc: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.
notes_loc: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师向他的周围释放死亡波纹，伤害敌方单位并<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友军单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 可怜的灵魂们，屈从于罗坦德吉利的瘟疫后遭到回收，沦为他用。
notes_loc: 死亡脉冲不能被躲避。

official.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
official.desc_loc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
official.lore_loc: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.
facets_loc: Necrophos gains movement speed equal to %movement_transfer%%% of the movement speed lost by enemies. Enemies lose %enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%% of the restoration amplification gained by Necrophos.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师步入将生者与死者相隔的领域。散发出一片灵气，减缓周围敌人的移动速度。在这个形态下，瘟疫法师为<font color='#57e550'>虚无</font>状态，无法攻击或被攻击，受到的魔法伤害增加，但是生命/魔法恢复效果加强。
officialZh.lore_loc: 罗坦德吉利利用手中的亡者灵魂搭建出从生到死的桥梁。
facets_loc: 瘟疫法师获得移动速度加成，数值等于%movement_transfer%%%敌人损失移速。敌人的恢复增强减少，数值等于瘟疫法师获得的%enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%%。

official.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
official.desc_loc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
official.lore_loc: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.
notes_loc: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
official.scepter_loc: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师让敌人的心脏停跳，使附近敌方单位按最大生命值一定百分比持续流失生命。
officialZh.lore_loc: 接近瘟疫法师就会感受到在他周围的空气中存在的瘟疫和灾祸。
notes_loc: 伤害不会禁用像闪烁匕首等物品。
不能作用于远古生物。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 竭心光环的生命流失伤害提升，数值为瘟疫法师当前生命恢复的%heal_regen_to_damage%%%。

official.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
official.desc_loc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
official.lore_loc: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
officialZh.desc_loc: <font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
officialZh.lore_loc: 空气中充斥的死亡和苦难增强了瘟疫法师的瘟疫魔法。
notes_loc: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。

special_values.name: damage_per_health
special_values.heading_loc: 每点损失生命值造成伤害：

official.name: necrolyte_sadist
official.desc_loc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_sadist
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师每次击杀单位都将获得可叠加的恢复效果，持续%regen_duration%秒。击杀英雄后获得数倍的效果。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_warlock
stats.npe_desc_loc: Summons powerful demons to fight at his side

official.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
official.desc_loc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
official.lore_loc: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
notes_loc: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

officialZh.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
officialZh.desc_loc: 将数个可见的敌方单位连接在一起，其中一人所受伤害的一定百分比会被其他所有人感受到。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一个远古咒语，能将多个生命体的生命能量连接成一个集合体。
notes_loc: 共享伤害的类型与原伤害相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

official.name: warlock_shadow_word
official.desc_loc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
official.lore_loc: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.

officialZh.name: warlock_shadow_word
officialZh.desc_loc: 术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。目标单位也会被<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 戴蒙的奥术有无穷的用途，可以用来强化友军也可以用作诅咒伤害敌人。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升作用范围。现在暗言术会施加给%cast_aoe%范围内%additional_targets%个额外单位，以英雄优先。额外单位的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>和伤害量减少%secondary_reduction%%%。

official.name: warlock_upheaval
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
official.lore_loc: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
notes_loc: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
official.shard_loc: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

officialZh.name: warlock_upheaval
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多%abilitychanneltime%秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速%duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 戴蒙操纵时空，削弱所有敌军。
notes_loc: 减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。
officialZh.shard_loc: 持续施法时每%imps_interval%秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

official.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
official.desc_loc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
official.lore_loc: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
official.scepter_loc: Calls %number_of_golems_scepter% Golems.
facets_loc: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.

officialZh.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
officialZh.desc_loc: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人%stun_duration%秒。地狱火持续%golem_duration%秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 戴蒙释放被他关在恐惧之木法杖中的异界灵魂，在敌阵中引发毁灭。
notes_loc: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 召唤%number_of_golems_scepter%个地狱火。
facets_loc: 混乱之祭地狱火会根据术士的生命和魔法恢复造成更高的永久献祭伤害。

official.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
official.desc_loc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
official.shard_loc: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

officialZh.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
officialZh.desc_loc: 只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_beastmaster
stats.npe_desc_loc: Summons beasts to aid his hunt

official.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
official.lore_loc: While learning to maneuver in nature alone, the Beastmaster also mastered the use of a pair of tomahawks, adept at cutting down trees as well as adversaries.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees.
official.shard_loc: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在独自学习野外生存时，兽王也掌握了飞斧的运用技巧，使他能够熟练地砍下树木，或者敌人的脑袋。
notes_loc: 此技能将摧毁树木。
officialZh.shard_loc: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

official.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
official.lore_loc: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 度过了与异兽互惠互助的孩童时期，兽王学会了如何随时召唤野兽。

official.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
official.lore_loc: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.
official.shard_loc: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王召唤%hawk_count%只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以%hawk_base_attack_interval%秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
officialZh.lore_loc: 度过了与异兽互惠互助的孩童时期，兽王学会了如何随时召唤野兽。
officialZh.shard_loc: 战鹰的持续时间提升%bonus_duration%秒，并且额外召唤一只战鹰。

official.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: The Beastmaster has learned to channel his primal instincts into an animalistic roar, causing devastation in the ranks of enemies.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得%movement_speed%%%移动速度提升，持续%movement_speed_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 兽王学会将他的原始本能凝聚为猛兽般的怒吼，在敌阵之中引发巨大的破坏。

official.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
official.desc_loc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
official.lore_loc: Beastmaster's ability to incite the innate strength of animals was seen in the mauling of the king of Slom.
notes_loc: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
facets_loc: Attack Speed bonus is increased by the number of units affected by Inner Beast.
Can be activated to increase Beastmaster's attack speed and allow him to apply the Wild Axes damage amplification debuff on his attack target.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
officialZh.desc_loc: 唤起兽王和他控制单位的内心狂怒，被动提高他们的攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 兽王激起野兽先天力量的能力，在他袭击斯洛姆国王时得到了展现。
notes_loc: 破坏会使被动攻击速度加成失效。
facets_loc: 攻击速度加成根据野性之心作用下的单位数量还会有所增加。
可以主动开启，提升兽王的攻击速度，并且他会对他的攻击目标施加野性之斧的伤害加深负面效果。

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_venomancer
stats.npe_desc_loc: Deals damage over time with venomous attacks

official.name: venomancer_venomous_gale
official.desc_loc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
official.lore_loc: A concoction of various stings, poisons, and toxins gathered from the jungles of Jidi Isle, victims surviving it are rare.
notes_loc: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every %tick_interval% seconds.
Slow starts at %movement_slow%%%, and decreases as time passes.
official.shard_loc: Increases cast range and projectile speed by %shard_travel_tooltip%%%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, %num_created_wards_tooltip% Plague Wards are created around them.

officialZh.name: venomancer_venomous_gale
officialZh.desc_loc: 沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一种由基迪岛丛林里搜集的各种毒针、毒液和毒素混合而成的药剂，几乎没有人能在沾到它后存活下来。
notes_loc: 瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每%tick_interval%秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为%movement_slow%%%，减速效果将逐渐降低。
officialZh.shard_loc: 施法距离和弹道速度提升%shard_travel_tooltip%%%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造%num_created_wards_tooltip%个瘟疫守卫。

official.name: venomancer_snakebite
official.desc_loc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

officialZh.name: venomancer_snakebite
officialZh.desc_loc: 剧毒术士召唤阿克特克的幼体，把它的毒牙刺入一个敌人，造成魔法伤害，并施加造成每秒伤害的剧毒。目标在感染时发动攻击，他就会再次受到初始伤害。

official.name: venomancer_plague_ward
official.desc_loc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
official.lore_loc: A mixture of his old herbalist talents and newfound toxic mastery creates a living embodiment of plague.

officialZh.name: venomancer_plague_ward
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 他通过将早先的草药学天赋，和后天获得的毒素专精混合起来，创造出一个活体化瘟疫。

official.name: venomancer_noxious_plague
official.desc_loc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
official.lore_loc: Deep in the heart of the jungles of Jidi, the seeds of extermination freely grow.
notes_loc: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
official.scepter_loc: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.

officialZh.name: venomancer_noxious_plague
officialZh.desc_loc: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在基迪岛丛林中心的深处，灭绝的种子自由地生长。
notes_loc: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

official.name: venomancer_poison_sting
official.desc_loc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
official.lore_loc: The paralytic sting of the creature which caused his transformation now belongs to the Venomancer.
notes_loc: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.
official.shard_loc: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

officialZh.name: venomancer_poison_sting
officialZh.desc_loc: 剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 造成他变异的生物身上的麻痹毒刺，现在属于剧毒术士了。
notes_loc: 毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。
officialZh.shard_loc: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

stats.name: npc_dota_hero_faceless_void
stats.npe_desc_loc: Can freeze his enemies in time

official.name: faceless_void_time_walk
official.desc_loc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Darkterror tears a hole in time, passing through Claszureme, and appearing back in an instant.
notes_loc: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.
official.scepter_loc: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_time_walk
officialZh.desc_loc: 冲到目标位置，并取消最近%backtrack_duration%秒内受到的任何伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 暗惧者将时间撕裂，穿过超维视界并瞬间重现。
notes_loc: 虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。

official.name: faceless_void_time_dilation
official.desc_loc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
official.lore_loc: For those facing off against Darkterror, each moment seems to stretch into eternity.
notes_loc: Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.
official.shard_loc: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_time_dilation
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚空假面将附近所有敌人困在一个时间膨胀场中，技能的冷却都会减慢。施加时每个受困的敌人都会获得一层时间膨胀的叠加效果，每有一个技能处于冷却就再获得一层。每层叠加效果造成每秒伤害，并降低移动速度和攻击速度降低。持续时间在时间结界作用下会暂停。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对于挑战暗惧者的人，每个时刻都像是延展成了永恒。
notes_loc: 不会影响物品的冷却时间。
效果期间叠加层数还会改变。施放技能后如果技能进入冷却就会提供一层叠加效果。如果技能冷却在时间膨胀期间完成，效果会被移除。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。

special_values.name: damage_per_stack
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加额外每秒伤害：

special_values.name: self_movespeed_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加自身移速加成：

special_values.name: self_attackspeed_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加自身攻速加成：

official.name: faceless_void_time_lock
official.desc_loc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
official.lore_loc: The strike of the Faceless Void lands with dimension shifting force.
notes_loc: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_time_lock
officialZh.desc_loc: 攻击有一定概率将一个敌方目标<font color='#2dd5e4'>锁定</font>在时间中，再次发动攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虚空假面的突袭伴随着维度转移之力。
notes_loc: 不与碎颅锤叠加。

official.name: faceless_void_chronosphere
official.desc_loc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
official.lore_loc: When a rift opens to Claszureme, all poor souls caught within will likely never return.
notes_loc: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_chronosphere
officialZh.desc_loc: 在时空中创造一个泡状遮罩，将所有位于其中的单位定住，并使虚空假面在其内部来去自如。只有虚空假面和他控制的单位不受影响。在其中的隐形敌人会显形。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当超维视界的裂隙突现之时，所有被其困住的可怜灵魂都将万劫不复。
notes_loc: 能够定住所有单位和建筑，不论敌我。除了虚空假面控制的单位。
虚空假面不受任何时间结界的影响。

official.name: faceless_void_distortion_field
official.desc_loc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_distortion_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚空假面附近%friendly_hero_distance%范围内以他或友方英雄为目标的敌方攻击弹道在进入目标%slow_distance_max%范围后会被减速%attack_projectile_slow%%%。
